note: Every value of all 3 columns over 2 rows, computed by tools/clickbench_hand.py from the statement above and compared as a multiset, because the order of two rows with the same ordering key is the engine's choice.
statement: SELECT CounterID, AVG(STRLEN(URL)) AS l, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits WHERE URL <> '' GROUP BY CounterID HAVING COUNT(*) > 100000 ORDER BY l DESC LIMIT 25
